title: Analysis of Indicators of Compromise
description:
This space enables analysts to investigate, track, and enrich threat intelligence by aggregating Indicators of Compromise (IoCs) and threat data from multiple cybersecurity sources.

**Capabilities:**
- Identify and analyze IoCs by type (URL, domain, IP, file hash) to assess threat relevance, prevalence, and activity timelines.
- Monitor and investigate attack trends by exploring first/last-seen timestamps, geographic origins, network associations (ASN, GeoIP), and relationships between IoCs and malware.
- Correlate threat intelligence from sources like open-source feeds (OpenThreat Exchange, AbuseURL, Malware Bazaar, AbuseMalware) to enrich incident response, prioritize threats, and support risk analysis.
- Segment and filter threat data by confidence score, action taken, threat type, and other relevant attributes for reporting or security operations.
- Reference additional context and technical details via linked blog post and source code.

**Limitations:**
- Does not provide real-time threat detection, response automation, or alerting—data is intended for investigation and enrichment.
- Lacks integration with endpoint/event telemetry or user/session context; focuses on threat indicators and external threat data.
- Underlying data quality and coverage depend on upstream sources, which may impact timeliness or completeness of intelligence.
